roles.functionStatement: Sustain fish populations and aquatic habitats to stated conservation and harvest objectives.

x4.reviewStatus: unreviewed agent candidate (not reviewed by a person)

bands.indicativeBand: GS-5 to GS-7 (entry); GS-9 to GS-11 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Manage fish populations and habitats to stated conservation and harvest objectives

tasks.statement: Sample fish populations by electrofishing, netting or hydroacoustics following the survey protocol to estimate abundance and size structure
Assess water quality and habitat conditions limiting a fish population, identifying the factors management can change
Estimate age, growth and mortality of a fish population from scale or otolith readings and catch-curve data

majorDuties.duty: Conduct fisheries stock assessments and develop management advice

tasks.statement: Fit a stock assessment model to catch, survey and biological data, documenting model diagnostics and retrospective patterns
Apply a data-limited assessment method to a stock with sparse catch and survey data, stating the uncertainty in reference points

majorDuties.duty: Capture, handle and mark wildlife and fish humanely and safely

tasks.statement: Capture animals with traps, nets or electrofishing following the approved animal-care protocol and permit conditions
Immobilize an animal chemically where authorized, monitoring vital signs until recovery and recording drug doses
Mark captured animals with tags or other marks while recording biological data within protocol handling-time and stress limits

majorDuties.duty: Operate small boats and work safely on water in aquatic, coastal and marine field settings

tasks.statement: Execute person-overboard, capsize and cold-water immersion procedures for a small-boat crew during drills and real events
Work sampling gear such as grabs, nets, sondes or traps over the side of a small vessel, keeping crew clear of lines and winches

majorDuties.duty: Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field

tasks.statement: Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection
Screen field measurement results against applicable water-quality criteria before leaving the site, triggering resampling or notification when an exceedance appears

majorDuties.duty: Apply field biosecurity and decontamination protocols

tasks.statement: Adapt the decontamination procedure on site when a new pathogen or invasive organism is suspected, escalating the finding before moving on
Decontaminate boots, gear, boats and vehicles between field sites with the protocol's method and contact time for the target organisms
Sequence site visits from lower-risk to higher-risk waters or stands so that crews cannot carry organisms from infested to uninfested sites

majorDuties.duty: Operate fish hatchery and aquatic propagation programmes

tasks.statement: Spawn broodstock following the genetic management plan's mating scheme, recording parentage for each lot
Monitor fish health in rearing units, recognizing disease signs and starting treatment under veterinary direction

majorDuties.duty: Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination

tasks.statement: Change sampling location, order or method on site when a likely contamination source is found, recording the source and the change

majorDuties.duty: Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference

tasks.statement: Choose the mix of field, sensor, remote-sensing and community methods for a monitoring programme from cost, detection and comparability evidence.

majorDuties.duty: Analyze environmental data statistically and interpret the results

tasks.statement: Estimate treatment effects on ecological response variables with a method suited to the design, reporting effect sizes and intervals.
Analyze trends in a long-term monitoring dataset, accounting for changes in methods, effort and detection over the record.

Recommend harvest regulations, stocking or habitat actions for a fishery from population assessment results and angler objectives

Estimate age, growth and mortality of a fish population from scale or otolith readings and catch-curve data
